response: Many patients do not understand their emergency department (ED) care or their discharge instructions. Unfortunately, most patients appear to be unaware of their lack of understanding and report inappropriate confidence in their comprehension and recall. This suggests that patients may not always recognize when they do not understand their care or instructions, which can lead to potential issues with adherence to treatment plans and overall health outcomes. Therefore, it is essential for healthcare providers to ensure that patients understand their care and instructions and to verify their comprehension to prevent misunderstandings and potential complications.
